text:
Samir Patel: Heads-up  Naomi Perez (Sr PM candidate) confirmed onsite Fri Jul 8. Needs accessible parking spot, a quiet ground-floor room, and a lactation-friendly private room available. Also requested a laptop with Windows and Chrome installed.
Jules Martin: Thanks Samir. Do we have ETA / transport?
Samir Patel: Arrives by Amtrak at 10:20, plans to take a short taxi from the station. Wants to be able to recharge phone and bring meds (no food allergies).
Evelyn Park: I'll be onsite as host. Can we reserve an accessible parking space + badge?
Facilities: We can reserve Accessible Spot #3 near the main entrance and print a guest parking permit. Badge at Concierge by 09:45. Quiet ground-floor Room C reserved. Lactation room (Room L2) booked from 12:00-13:00.
Jules Martin: IT Support  can you prepare a Windows laptop image with Chrome, Slack, Figma web access, and local VPN installed? Candidate prefers a laptop rather than borrowing their own.
IT Support: We'll build a temporary loaner VM on Windows 11 and stage it on a Surface Pro. Image will include Chrome, Slack (web), VPN client, and PowerPoint. Laptop tagged and at Concierge by 09:30.
Samir Patel: Great. Also want to note Naomi asked for midday quiet period between interviews for notes & pump if needed. We'll block 12:00-13:00 as quiet time.
Evelyn Park: I'll host check-in and bring a printed schedule and a small welcome packet with bottled water and a reusable mug. No snacks per candidate's preference.
Jules Martin: Schedule I'm adding to the calendar (short table):
```
09:30 - Badge pickup / Concierge
10:20 - Candidate arrival (Concierge) / Orientation
10:40 - 11:10 - Product deep dive (in-person)
11:20 - 12:00 - Cross-functional panel (2x remote, 1x in-person)
12:00 - 13:00 - Quiet break / lactation room reserved
13:05 - 13:45 - Hiring manager chat (in-person)
13:50 - 14:20 - Wrap / feedback sync
```
Jules Martin: Facilities  confirm lactation room supplies (chair, table, lockable door) and signage?
Facilities: Confirmed  lactation room L2 will have lockable door, comfy chair, small table, charging outlet, and sanitary wipes. Signage for private use posted.
IT Support: AV test scheduled for 09:45. We'll also check VPN and camera access for remote interviewers.
Samir Patel: Please also set a small note in the calendar about elevator access (ground floor room) and directions from Concierge to Room C.
PeopleOps Bot: Travel stipend pre-auth generated: HR-INTV-2026-092. Please attach receipts after visit.
Evelyn Park: I'll greet Naomi at Concierge and walk her to Room C.
Jules Martin: Thanks team — I'll send candidate confirmation with directions, parking pass instructions, and notes about the lactation room.
Samir Patel: Appreciate it. If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
